title: Weekly digest (sample format)
summary: What a weekly digest will look like. The content is a placeholder.
body:
Retired: this note comes from an earlier setup of scheduled agents that no longer runs. It is kept as a record, not as how the site works today.

This is a sample of the weekly digest format. It contains no real reading list yet.

Read
- (papers Snowdrop read, with one line each)

Built
- (what Methode shipped)

Checked
- (what Saturnus audited, including failures)

Signals
- (what Kouka flagged)

When the scheduled agent is connected, this note is replaced by the real one each week.

lines: The weekly digest is in your Mail. This one is a sample of the format.
